title: Singlife Davao Marathon 2026 Review: What the 2026 Edition Was Like
seo_title: Singlife Davao Marathon 2026 Review | SM Lanang, Davao
meta_description: Singlife Davao Marathon 2026 review: about 3,000 runners on an out-and-back course from SM Lanang on 15 August, a Kenyan 2:25 win and full Filipino results.
dek: The Singlife Davao Marathon was run from SM Lanang Premier on 15 August 2026, during the Kadayawan Festival. Here is what it was like, from the report on it.
verdict: The Singlife Davao Marathon is a mid-sized marathon with a fast front end. About 3,000 runners took part on Saturday 15 August 2026, on an out-and-back course starting at SM Lanang Premier [1]. Kenya's Victor Kipkemei Chepkwony won in 2:25:37 and Ziporah Wanjiru Kingori in 2:49:50, while Edsel Moral and Christine Hallasgo led the Filipino division [1]. If you want a competitive marathon in Mindanao, timed with the city's Kadayawan Festival [2], it is a strong option. The report says nothing about conditions, so plan for tropical heat.

sections.heading: The 2026 Edition
paragraphs: The race was run on Saturday 15 August 2026 on an out-and-back course that started at SM Lanang Premier in Davao City [1]. About three thousand runners took part, according to SM Supermalls-Mindanao [1].
The full marathon is the headline race, with results split into an international and a Filipino division [1].

sections.heading: The Front of the Race
paragraphs: Kenyan runners dominated the open marathon. Victor Kipkemei Chepkwony won the men's race in 2:25:37, ahead of David Kipkorir Rono (2:26:43) and Gilbert Cheruyot Muge (2:29:27), and Ziporah Wanjiru Kingori won the women's in 2:49:50, ahead of Pamela Chepkoech Bundotich and Caroline Cherono [1].

In the Filipino division, Edsel Moral won the men's race in 2:33:52, ahead of Rick Organiza (2:35:05) and James Kevin Cruz (2:36:39), and Christine Hallasgo won the women's in 3:03:16, ahead of Maricar Camacho (3:23:00) and Lizane Juay Abella (3:26:37) [1].

sections.heading: Should You Enter Next Year?
paragraphs: If you want a marathon in Mindanao with a competitive field, yes. The international division brings sub-2:30 runners, and a separate Filipino division means local podiums are decided among local runners.
It is a tropical marathon, so pace for heat and humidity, and check the start time and course map when entries open.
This review is compiled from a published race report on the 2026 edition. It is not a first-hand race report, and nobody from this site ran the race.
